color_palette.name: Axiom Slate
color_palette.usage: Primary site background and dashboard panel surfaces — the deep analytical ground that anchors all data-heavy layouts, used across hero sections, navigation bar, footer, and stat card backgrounds

color_palette.name: Grid Chalk
color_palette.usage: Secondary surface for content cards, gallery overlays, and feature grid panels — provides high-contrast legibility against Axiom Slate while maintaining the cool, technical register of a data environment

color_palette.name: Civic Blueprint
color_palette.usage: Primary action color for CTAs, interactive links, active navigation states, metric card highlights, and chart data series — the dominant blue that reads as analytical authority and civic precision

color_palette.name: Measured Teal
color_palette.usage: Secondary data accent for positive outcome metrics, project success indicators, and gallery category tags — used in stats sections and project listing badges to signal measurable civic impact

color_palette.name: Fieldwork Amber
color_palette.usage: Alert-weight accent for callout statistics, FAQ highlight markers, and eyebrow labels on light surfaces — signals critical data points and draws the eye to key quantitative findings in dense layouts

color_palette.name: Survey Line
color_palette.usage: Body text on light surfaces, table borders, grid rule lines, and secondary panel backgrounds — the mid-tone structural slate that organizes dense information hierarchies without competing with primary content

color_palette.name: Datum White
color_palette.usage: Primary text on dark panel surfaces, metric numerals in stat blocks, and full-bleed gallery caption overlays — pure white deployed for maximum contrast in data-dense and gallery-first contexts

color_palette.name: Plinth Gray
color_palette.usage: Metadata labels, caption text, secondary stat descriptors, team member titles, and inactive navigation items — the quiet annotation tone that populates the dense supporting layer across all pages

typography.heading_treatment: DM Sans at display weights (700–800) in tight tracking (−0.02em to −0.04em), all-caps for H1 hero headlines to enforce the analytical, data-dashboard register; sentence case for H2 and H3 with clear weight steps down through the hierarchy. Large numerals in stat blocks set at display scale to dominate the visual field like dashboard KPIs.
typography.body_treatment: IBM Plex Sans at 15–16px with 1.6 line-height and moderate measure (60–72ch), reflecting the compact sans-serif density expected of a technical, data-heavy environment. Used for all descriptive copy, feature grid descriptions, FAQ answers, and team bios — precise and legible without editorial warmth.
typography.accent_treatment: IBM Plex Mono in uppercase at 11–13px with wide letter-spacing (0.12em–0.18em) for eyebrow labels, metric unit annotations, project category tags, stat captions, and form field labels — the monospace voice that signals data provenance and technical rigor at every small-scale touchpoint.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Home page for Axiom Public Lab is a data-dashboard-meets-civic-gallery composition that opens with maximum analytical authority and progressively reveals methodology depth. Three sections move from full-bleed darkness (hero) to a high-contrast data strip (stats) to a structured grid panel (feature grid), creating a deliberate dense→measured→organized rhythm rather than the predictable alternating-off-white template.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The hero section contains the page's defining visual move — the headline "Every Square Meter Has a Story. We Read It First." is set at extreme display scale (DM Sans 800 weight, ~96–112px, tight tracking −0.04em) spanning nearly the full viewport width as a left-anchored typographic wall. The word "READ" is isolated on its own line and rendered in Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) while the remaining lines hold in Datum White (#FFFFFF) against the Axiom Slate (#1C2333) full-bleed background. Beneath this typographic mass, a horizontal grid-rule line in Survey Line (#334155) at 1px runs edge-to-edge, functioning as a dashboard separator — a data-environment structural device, not decoration. This is a typographic stunt native to the data-heavy aesthetic: the headline is not beside content, it IS the content, dominating the viewport the way a KPI headline dominates a dashboard panel.

SECTION RHYTHM AND VARIETY:
— Section 1 (Hero): Full-bleed Axiom Slate surface. Asymmetric left-anchored layout. Oversized display headline as the primary visual element. CTA pair sits flush-left in a compact inline row below a thin horizontal rule, not stacked. The eyebrow is IBM Plex Mono uppercase, Fieldwork Amber (#D97706), 12px, 0.16em tracking — it reads as a dashboard label pinned to the top-left. Subheadline is IBM Plex Sans 17px, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8), set in a constrained 52ch column aligned left under the rule. No illustration, no split column — the typography is the visual.
— Section 2 (Stats): Full-width Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) surface — a saturated color block that breaks the dark/light alternation and signals a data-dense interlude. Four metric cards are arranged in a tight 4-column horizontal strip. Numerals are IBM Plex Mono at display scale (~72px), Datum White. Unit labels are IBM Plex Mono uppercase, 11px, Fieldwork Amber (#D97706). Descriptions are IBM Plex Sans 13px, Datum White at 80% opacity. Vertical Survey Line rules separate the four columns. This section has no CTA — it is purely evidential.
— Section 3 (Feature Grid): Grid Chalk (#F0F2F5) surface. Three methodology pillars in an asymmetric 3-column layout where the leftmost column is wider (5 of 12 grid columns) and holds the section headline and eyebrow as a fixed anchor, while the two right columns hold the first two methodology cards, and a third card spans below in a 2-column offset to break symmetry. Each card has a Civic Blueprint left-border rule (3px), a Measured Teal (#0D9488) category tag in IBM Plex Mono, and Survey Line body text. CTA sits flush-left below the grid, not centered.

COLOR SURFACE LOGIC: Axiom Slate (hero) → Civic Blueprint (stats) → Grid Chalk (feature grid). This sequence avoids the alternating off-white trap by inserting a full saturated panel as the middle register, making the page feel like a dashboard with distinct data zones rather than a marketing scroll.

TYPOGRAPHY HIERARCHY: DM Sans 700–800 for all headlines; IBM Plex Sans 15–16px for body/subheadlines; IBM Plex Mono uppercase 11–13px for all eyebrows, unit labels, category tags, and metadata. Numerals in stats always IBM Plex Mono at display scale. No editorial warmth — all type is precise and functional.

DENSITY LOGIC: Hero is typographically dense but spatially open (large type, controlled whitespace around it). Stats strip is maximally dense — four metrics compressed into a tight horizontal band with minimal padding. Feature grid returns to a measured, structured density with deliberate column gutters and card padding. The page breathes in a dense→denser→structured pattern.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On mobile, the hero headline steps down to ~48px and wraps naturally over 3–4 lines, preserving the typographic wall feel. The stats strip collapses to a 2×2 grid with the same Civic Blueprint surface. The feature grid stacks to single-column with the headline anchor above the cards. The asymmetric feature grid offset is dropped on mobile; all three cards stack vertically. IBM Plex Mono eyebrows and labels remain at their specified sizes across all breakpoints — they must not scale down further as they are already at minimum legibility.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
HERO SECTION — Full-bleed Axiom Slate (#1C2333) background occupying 100vw × 92vh minimum. No imagery, no illustration, no split-column — this is a pure typographic hero where the headline is the dominant visual object.

LAYOUT: Left-anchored, asymmetric. All content aligns to the left edge of a 12-column grid with 80px horizontal gutters on desktop. The right ~30% of the viewport remains intentionally empty, creating negative-space tension that reinforces the analytical register.

EYEBROW: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 12px, letter-spacing 0.16em, Fieldwork Amber (#D97706). Text: 'Public Space Design Lab'. Positioned top-left of the content column, 64px from the top of the section. Preceded by a 24px horizontal rule line in Fieldwork Amber (#D97706) at 1.5px weight that sits to the left of the eyebrow text — functioning as a dashboard label marker. The eyebrow + rule sit inline: [rule] [eyebrow text].

HEADLINE: DM Sans, weight 800, ~96px on desktop (fluid between 72px and 112px), tracking −0.04em. Spans approximately 8 of 12 grid columns. Three-line break:
Line 1: 'Every Square Meter' — Datum White (#FFFFFF)
Line 2: 'Has a Story. We' — Datum White (#FFFFFF)
Line 3: 'READ IT FIRST.' — Civic Blueprint (#2563EB), all-caps, same weight and size
The color shift on 'READ IT FIRST.' is the section's signature typographic stunt — the action verb rendered in the primary data-authority blue functions like a highlighted KPI in a dashboard panel. Tight line-height: 1.05em.

HORIZONTAL RULE: Immediately below the headline, a full-width (100% of content column) 1px horizontal rule in Survey Line (#334155) serves as a dashboard separator. Margin: 28px above and below the rule. This rule is a structural device borrowed from data-grid aesthetics — it visually closes the headline block and opens the subheadline/CTA zone.

SUBHEADLINE: IBM Plex Sans, 17px, line-height 1.6, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8). Constrained to 52ch max-width, left-aligned. Text: 'Axiom Public Lab fuses pedestrian flow data, environmental metrics, and community research to design public spaces that perform as well as they inspire.' Set 28px below the rule.

CTA ROW: Two CTAs in an inline horizontal pair, flush-left, 32px below the subheadline. No stacking.
— Primary CTA 'Explore Our Projects': Solid Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) fill, Datum White (#FFFFFF) text, DM Sans 600 14px, 14px vertical / 28px horizontal padding, 0px border-radius (hard-edged, consistent with data-dashboard component style).
— Secondary CTA 'Start an Inquiry': No fill, 1px Datum White (#FFFFFF) border, Datum White text, same sizing. Hard-edged.
CTAs sit side by side with a 16px gap.

BOTTOM ANCHOR: At the very bottom of the hero, a thin full-width 1px rule in Survey Line (#334155) marks the section boundary — the same grid-rule language carried throughout the data-heavy aesthetic.

SPACING: 120px top padding, 96px bottom padding on desktop. Section is not vertically centered — content sits in the upper 60% of the viewport, leaving breathing room below the CTA row before the bottom rule.

RESPONSIVE: On tablet, headline scales to ~64px, column expands to 10 of 12. On mobile, headline at 42px, full-width column, CTA pair stacks vertically with 12px gap.

STATS SECTION — Full-width Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) surface. This is the page's saturated color break — a bold, data-dense interlude that reads as a dashboard KPI strip. No eyebrow label at top; instead the section headline is set as a compact masthead above the metric row.

SECTION HEADLINE: DM Sans, weight 700, 22px, Datum White (#FFFFFF), sentence case, left-aligned within the content column. Text: 'Civic Design, Backed by Evidence'. Eyebrow above it: IBM Plex Mono uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.18em, Fieldwork Amber (#D97706). Text: 'By the Numbers'. Eyebrow sits 8px above the headline. Combined headline+eyebrow block sits 48px from the top of the section, left-aligned.

METRIC STRIP: Four metric cards arranged in a strict 4-column horizontal grid, separated by vertical 1px rules in Datum White at 20% opacity. The strip sits 36px below the headline block and runs the full content-column width. Each card is left-aligned within its column with 32px internal left padding.

PER CARD ANATOMY:
— Numeral: IBM Plex Mono, weight 700, 72px, Datum White (#FFFFFF), tight line-height 1.0. The number dominates the card like a KPI readout. Values: '47', '3.2M', '91%', '18'.
— Unit label: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.16em, Fieldwork Amber (#D97706). Sits 6px below the numeral on a new line. Values: 'Projects', 'People Reached', 'Satisfaction Rate', 'Civic Partners'.
— Description: IBM Plex Sans, 13px, line-height 1.5, Datum White at 75% opacity. Sits 12px below the unit label. Max 28ch per card to keep it tight. Values from section items.

No CTA in this section — it is purely evidential and self-contained. The density here is maximum: four data points compressed into a horizontal band with no decorative padding.

SECTION PADDING: 56px top, 64px bottom. The tighter vertical padding relative to the hero reinforces the 'dense data strip' register.

BOTTOM BOUNDARY: A full-width 1px rule in Datum White at 15% opacity marks the bottom edge before transitioning to the Grid Chalk feature grid section.

RESPONSIVE: On tablet, cards collapse to 2×2 grid, vertical rules replaced by horizontal 1px rules between rows. On mobile, single-column stack with each card separated by a horizontal rule. Numerals scale to 56px on mobile.

FEATURE GRID SECTION — Grid Chalk (#F0F2F5) surface. This section breaks the repeated three-equal-column card pattern by using an asymmetric anchor-left layout where the section header occupies a fixed left column and the methodology cards populate the remaining space in an offset arrangement.

OVERALL GRID: 12-column grid. Section header anchor: columns 1–4 (left, 4 wide). Card zone: columns 5–12 (right, 8 wide). This creates a deliberate left-right split that avoids the centered-three-card default.

LEFT ANCHOR COLUMN (cols 1–4):
— Eyebrow: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 12px, letter-spacing 0.16em, Measured Teal (#0D9488). Text: 'Our Method'. Sits at the top of the content zone.
— Headline: DM Sans, weight 800, 36px, tracking −0.02em, Survey Line (#334155). Text: 'Design Decisions Grounded in Real Urban Data'. Line-height 1.15. Sits 10px below eyebrow.
— Subheadline: IBM Plex Sans, 15px, line-height 1.6, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8). Text: 'We don't guess what a community needs. We measure it.' Sits 20px below headline.
— CTA 'See Our Services': Sits 32px below the subheadline. DM Sans 600 13px, Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) text, no fill, 1px Civic Blueprint border, 10px vertical / 20px horizontal padding, 0px border-radius. Hard-edged. Left-aligned.
— A vertical 2px rule in Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) runs the full height of the anchor column on its right edge, separating it from the card zone. This functions as a structural grid-line device native to the data-heavy aesthetic.

RIGHT CARD ZONE (cols 5–12): Three methodology cards arranged in an asymmetric 2-then-1 offset layout:
— Row 1: Two cards side by side, each spanning 4 columns (cols 5–8 and 9–12). 24px gap between them.
— Row 2: One card spanning columns 5–9 only (5 wide), leaving columns 10–12 empty — a deliberate off-grid break that resists full symmetry. 24px gap between rows.

PER CARD ANATOMY:
— Left border: 3px solid Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) on the card's left edge.
— Category tag: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.16em, Measured Teal (#0D9488). Rendered as a small tag above the title. Values: 'Behavioral Analysis', 'Environmental Data', 'Community Research' (inferred from item context).
— Card title: DM Sans, weight 700, 18px, Survey Line (#334155). Values: 'Behavioral Mapping', 'Environmental Performance Modeling', 'Community Data Synthesis'.
— Card body: IBM Plex Sans, 15px, line-height 1.6, Survey Line (#334155) at 85% opacity. Full description text from section items.
— Card background: Datum White (#FFFFFF). Card has no border-radius (hard-edged). A subtle 1px border in Plinth Gray (#94A3B8) at 40% opacity wraps the remaining three sides.
— Internal card padding: 24px all sides.

SECTION PADDING: 80px top, 96px bottom on desktop. The increased bottom padding creates a measured exhale after the dense stats strip.

RESPONSIVE: On tablet, the anchor column collapses to full-width above the card zone (stacked layout). Cards move to 2-column then 1-column on mobile. The vertical Civic Blueprint rule is hidden on mobile. The asymmetric row-2 offset collapses to full card width on mobile.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Projects page is a gallery-first, data-annotated portfolio showcase for Axiom Public Lab. It operates in three distinct registers across three sections, each with a deliberately different skeleton to prevent templating: a masthead-style page header, a dominant full-bleed image gallery with data overlays, and a dashboard-panel stats block. The page never repeats the same column structure twice.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The gallery section (Section 2) contains the page's defining visual move — an oversized typographic data-stamp reading "47 SPACES / 14 CITIES" rendered in IBM Plex Mono at display scale (clamp 80–120px), set in Civic Blueprint (#2563EB), positioned flush-left and bleeding slightly off the left grid edge above the gallery grid. This is not a headline — it is a structural annotation that behaves like a dashboard KPI dominating the visual field, a direct expression of the data-heavy aesthetic applied at gallery-first amplitude. It anchors the section before a single image loads, treating numbers as architecture.

SURFACE RHYTHM: Section 1 (page header) sits on Axiom Slate (#1C2333) — dark, analytical, authoritative. Section 2 (gallery) transitions to Grid Chalk (#F0F2F5) as its ground, letting project photography dominate against a cool neutral. Section 3 (stats) returns to Axiom Slate, closing the page with a dashboard-panel density. This dark–light–dark rhythm creates visual punctuation without alternating arbitrarily.

COLOR USAGE: Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) carries the oversized typographic data-stamp, active metadata tags, and the CTA in Section 2. Measured Teal (#0D9488) marks project typology badges on gallery cards. Fieldwork Amber (#D97706) highlights the eyebrow labels in Sections 1 and 3 and the key outcome metric in each stat card. Plinth Gray (#94A3B8) handles all caption and metadata annotation text. Survey Line (#334155) draws the grid rule lines between gallery cells and table borders in the stats block. Datum White (#FFFFFF) carries all body and headline text on dark surfaces.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY: DM Sans 700–800 for all headlines, tight tracking (−0.03em). IBM Plex Sans 15–16px / 1.6 line-height for body and descriptions. IBM Plex Mono uppercase 11–13px / 0.15em letter-spacing for all eyebrow labels, metadata annotations, unit labels, and category tags. Large stat numerals in Section 3 are set in DM Sans at display scale (clamp 56–80px) in Datum White, with unit labels in IBM Plex Mono beneath.

DENSITY / WHITESPACE: Section 1 is sparse — wide vertical padding (120px top / 80px bottom), minimal copy, the headline dominates. Section 2 is the densest — tight grid gutters (16px), data overlays on every card, the signature typographic stamp compressing the space above the grid. Section 3 is medium-dense — four stat cards in a horizontal dashboard row with internal padding, separated by Survey Line vertical rules, set on Axiom Slate.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On mobile, the gallery collapses from a 3-column masonry-style grid to a single-column stacked card layout. The oversized data-stamp in Section 2 scales down via clamp but remains the first visual element encountered, still flush-left. Stat cards in Section 3 stack 2×2 on tablet and 1×4 vertically on mobile. The page header in Section 1 remains single-column at all breakpoints. Navigation and footer follow the shared design system dark-surface treatment.

GRID: 12-column base grid with 24px gutters at desktop. Gallery cards span 4 columns each (3 per row), with the signature data-stamp spanning all 12 columns above. Stats cards each span 3 columns (4 per row). Page header content is left-aligned within columns 1–8 on desktop.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
SECTION 1 — PAGE HEADER (type: page_header). Surface: Axiom Slate (#1C2333) full-width background. Padding: 120px top, 80px bottom. Grid: 12-column; all content sits within columns 1–8 (left-aligned, asymmetric — do not center). No asset. No image.

EYEBROW: 'OUR WORK' in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 12px, letter-spacing 0.16em, Fieldwork Amber (#D97706). Sits 0px above the headline with 0 margin between eyebrow and headline — tight stack.

HEADLINE: 'Public Spaces Built on Proof, Not Assumption' in DM Sans 800 weight, approximately 52–60px (clamp), tracking −0.03em, sentence case, Datum White (#FFFFFF). This is the dominant typographic element of the section. Allow it to break naturally across two lines within the 8-column container — do not force a single line.

SUBHEADLINE: 'Each project begins with a dataset and ends with a place people choose to return to.' in IBM Plex Sans, 17px, weight 400, line-height 1.6, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8). Set 24px below the headline, within the same 8-column container. This is the only body-level copy in the section — keep it short and unadorned.

HORIZONTAL RULE: A 1px Survey Line (#334155) rule spans the full 12-column width at the very bottom of the section, flush with the section's bottom edge, acting as a structural grid divider before the gallery section begins. This is not decorative — it is a data-dashboard grid line that signals the transition from orientation to evidence.

NO CTAs in this section. No cards, no images, no icons. The section derives its authority from restraint and typographic weight alone. The dark surface and left-aligned hierarchy position this as a masthead-style orientation block — analytical, not welcoming.

SECTION 2 — GALLERY (type: gallery). Surface: Grid Chalk (#F0F2F5) full-width background. Padding: 72px top, 80px bottom. Grid: 12-column, 16px gutters.

SIGNATURE MOMENT — TYPOGRAPHIC DATA-STAMP: Before the gallery grid, spanning all 12 columns, render the text '47 SPACES / 14 CITIES' in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, at display scale (clamp 72px–112px), weight 700, color Civic Blueprint (#2563EB), left-aligned and deliberately bleeding 16–24px off the left grid edge (outside the standard column margin) to break the grid and assert dashboard-KPI dominance. Below this stamp, on the same left-flush baseline, set 'ONE METHODOLOGY.' in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, same scale, Axiom Slate (#1C2333). These two lines together form the section's structural headline — they are not decorative; they are the visual anchor that makes this section the page's signature moment. Below the two-line stamp, set a 1px Survey Line (#334155) rule spanning the full 12 columns, 24px below the stamp, before the gallery grid begins.

EYEBROW: 'PORTFOLIO' in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.15em, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8), positioned 0px above the typographic data-stamp with 16px margin between eyebrow and stamp.

GALLERY GRID: A 3-column × 2-row grid of project cards, each card spanning 4 columns. Cards have no outer border-radius (flat, hard-edged — consistent with data-heavy aesthetic). Card height is fixed at approximately 420px on desktop. Each card is structured as a full-bleed project photograph (occupying the top 65% of the card height) with a data-annotation panel below (occupying the bottom 35%). The photograph fills the card top with object-fit cover; no border-radius on image.

CARD DATA PANEL: Background Axiom Slate (#1C2333). Padding 16px. Contains:
— Project title in DM Sans 600, 16px, Datum White (#FFFFFF), sentence case, no truncation (allow 2 lines).
— One-line description excerpt in IBM Plex Sans 13px, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8), clamped to 2 lines with ellipsis.
— Metadata row: three inline chips for Type, Year, and Area — each chip in IBM Plex Mono uppercase 10px, letter-spacing 0.14em, Survey Line (#334155) background with 1px Survey Line border, Plinth Gray text, 4px vertical / 8px horizontal padding, 2px border-radius (minimal).
— Typology badge: flush-right within the metadata row, in IBM Plex Mono uppercase 10px, Measured Teal (#0D9488) background, Datum White text — signals civic typology category.

ON HOVER (card): The project photograph gains a Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) overlay at 20% opacity, and the card title transitions to Civic Blueprint. A subtle 'VIEW PROJECT →' label in IBM Plex Mono 11px Datum White appears centered over the image. No scaling or shadow animation — flat, precise, data-dashboard behavior.

PROJECT ITEMS (6 total, in order): Meridian Plaza — Rotterdam, Kestrel Linear Park — Toronto, Foundry Commons — Detroit, Solstice Promenade — Seville, Tidal Threshold Park — Singapore, Harrow Market Square — London. Each card uses a distinct project photograph as the full-bleed image (placeholder photography: waterfront plaza aerial, greenway corridor, industrial civic square, shaded boulevard, coastal park, commercial market square — all photographed at the civic/urban scale, no tight human portraits).

CTA: Below the gallery grid, 40px margin, a single left-aligned CTA button: 'Discuss a Project' in IBM Plex Mono uppercase 12px, letter-spacing 0.14em, Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) background, Datum White text, 0px border-radius (flat rectangle), 14px vertical / 28px horizontal padding. Do not center this button — it is flush-left within the 12-column grid, aligned with the left edge of the gallery. No secondary CTA.

RESPONSIVE: At tablet (768–1024px), gallery becomes 2-column grid (cards span 6 columns). At mobile (<768px), single-column stacked cards. The data-stamp scales via clamp and remains the first visual element, still flush-left.

SECTION 3 — STATS (type: stats). Surface: Axiom Slate (#1C2333) full-width background. Padding: 80px top, 96px bottom. Grid: 12-column.

EYEBROW: 'PORTFOLIO OUTCOMES' in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.16em, Fieldwork Amber (#D97706). Left-aligned within columns 1–6. 0px margin between eyebrow and headline.

HEADLINE: 'Measurable Impact Across Every Typology' in DM Sans 700, 36px, tracking −0.02em, sentence case, Datum White (#FFFFFF). Left-aligned within columns 1–8. Set 8px below the eyebrow. This is the section's structural label — authoritative but not the dominant visual element (the stat numerals are).

HORIZONTAL RULE: A 1px Survey Line (#334155) rule spans the full 12 columns, 32px below the headline, before the stat cards begin. This is a dashboard grid-line separator consistent with the data-heavy visual system.

STAT CARDS ROW: Four stat cards in a single horizontal row, each spanning 3 columns. Cards are separated by 1px vertical Survey Line (#334155) rules (not gaps — the rule runs the full card height, flush between cards). Cards have no background fill — they sit directly on Axiom Slate, making the numerals appear to float on the dark panel surface. Internal padding: 32px top, 24px sides, 0px bottom.

Each stat card layout (top to bottom):
— NUMERAL: The key metric ('+58%', '14', '6', '2.4B') in DM Sans 800 weight, clamp 56px–80px, Datum White (#FFFFFF). For '2.4B', append a superscript 'USD' label in IBM Plex Mono uppercase 13px, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8), vertically aligned to the top of the numeral. For '+58%', the '+' and '%' characters remain in Datum White at the same scale — do not reduce them.
— ACCENT RULE: A 2px horizontal rule, 40px wide, Fieldwork Amber (#D97706), positioned 12px below the numeral, left-aligned within the card. This is the Fieldwork Amber's structural role in this section — a precision marker beneath each KPI, like a data chart axis tick.
— DESCRIPTION: The stat description text in IBM Plex Sans 14px, line-height 1.5, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8), set 12px below the accent rule. Maximum 3 lines. No truncation.

Stat items in order: '+58%' (average dwell time increase), '14' (cities), '6' (civic typologies), '2.4B USD' (combined infrastructure value).

NO CTAs in this section. No images. The section closes the page on a dense, authoritative, dashboard-panel register — four KPIs presented as evidence, not marketing. The dark surface mirrors Section 1, completing the dark–light–dark rhythm of the page.

RESPONSIVE: At tablet, stat cards collapse to a 2×2 grid (each card spans 6 columns), with the vertical Survey Line rules replaced by horizontal 1px rules between rows. At mobile, stat cards stack vertically single-column, each card full-width with a bottom border rule in Survey Line.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Services page for Axiom Public Lab operates as a dense, analytical document — closer in spirit to a technical briefing than a marketing brochure. The three sections move through a deliberate rhythm: a masthead-style page header that anchors the page with typographic authority, a full-weight feature grid that functions as a phased project methodology dashboard, and a tightly structured FAQ that closes the page with precision and institutional credibility.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The feature grid section (Section 2) contains the page's defining visual move — an oversized, monospaced phase counter system running down the left rail of the grid. Each service card displays its phase number ("01" through "06") in IBM Plex Mono at display scale (~96–120px), rendered in Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) at very low opacity (~12%) as a background watermark behind the card surface, while the same phase number appears at full weight in Measured Teal (#0D9488) at 13px in the card's top-left corner as a data label. This creates a layered, dashboard-panel effect where the data annotation exists simultaneously at two scales — a move that is analytically inevitable for a data-heavy aesthetic and directly echoes the visual_cues of metric cards and dashboard panels. This is not a decorative flourish; it is a structural device that organizes the six service phases into a scannable, KPI-style grid.

SURFACE AND COLOR LOGIC: Section 1 (page header) sits on Axiom Slate (#1C2333) — the deep analytical ground — with Datum White (#FFFFFF) for the headline and Plinth Gray (#94A3B8) for the subheadline. Section 2 (feature grid) breaks to Grid Chalk (#F0F2F5) as the page surface, with individual service cards on Datum White (#FFFFFF) bordered by Survey Line (#334155) at 1px. The phase watermarks in Civic Blueprint and the teal data labels create chromatic density without overwhelming the card surfaces. Section 3 (FAQ) returns to Axiom Slate (#1C2333), mirroring Section 1 and creating a dark-light-dark sandwich that gives the page structural bookending — appropriate for a data-heavy, analytical register.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY: DM Sans at 700–800 weight governs all headlines. The page header H1 is set in all-caps with tight tracking (−0.03em) at ~56–64px on desktop. Section 2's H2 is sentence case at ~36px. Section 3's H2 is sentence case at ~32px. IBM Plex Mono handles all eyebrow labels, phase tags, and metadata annotations at 11–12px with 0.15em letter-spacing in uppercase. IBM Plex Sans governs all body copy and FAQ answers at 15–16px with 1.6 line-height. Fieldwork Amber (#D97706) is used for eyebrow labels on dark surfaces (Sections 1 and 3) to create the alert-weight accent that signals section entry points.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Team page for Axiom Public Lab operates as an editorial document — analytical in structure, humanizing in intent — built on the data-heavy aesthetic at full amplitude. The page is composed of three sections with deliberately varied skeletons: a masthead-style page header that reads like a dashboard title bar, a dense multi-column team roster grid with profile cards that carry metric-style metadata, and a full-bleed story block anchored by a founding-year callout and long-form body copy. No two sections share the same structural skeleton.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The page header's headline — "The Analysts Who Also Know How to Draw" — is set as an oversized, left-aligned display type block in DM Sans 800 weight at approximately 72–80px, with the word "Draw" isolated on its own line and rendered in Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) against the Axiom Slate (#1C2333) background. A horizontal rule in IBM Plex Mono uppercase annotation style runs beneath the headline at full column width, styled as a data-table separator line in Survey Line (#334155) at 1px. This typographic stunt — the color break mid-headline combined with the monospace rule — is the page's signature moment. It signals that this is not a standard "meet the team" page but a data studio's personnel manifest. The move is inevitable for this aesthetic: it borrows the visual grammar of a dashboard KPI card where the key number breaks color to demand attention, applied here to a single word that carries the page's conceptual tension.

SECTION RHYTHM AND SURFACE LOGIC:
— Section 1 (page header): Full-width, Axiom Slate (#1C2333) background. Dense, left-aligned masthead layout. Minimal vertical padding — tight like a dashboard title bar. No imagery. Pure type.
— Section 2 (team grid): Grid Chalk (#F0F2F5) background. The high-contrast surface shift from Section 1 creates a sharp analytical cut. Dense 3-column card grid on desktop. Each card is a dashboard panel with a ruled top border in Civic Blueprint, a name/title block, metadata tag in IBM Plex Mono, and body description. This is the densest, most data-heavy section on the page.
— Section 3 (story block): Returns to Axiom Slate (#1C2333). Asymmetric two-column split: a large left column carries the body narrative in IBM Plex Sans, while the right column holds an oversized founding year "2010" rendered in DM Sans 800 at display scale (~140px) in Fieldwork Amber (#D97706), functioning like a KPI numeral in a stat block. The CTA is left-aligned, styled as a Civic Blueprint filled button with Datum White text.

COLOR WORK ACROSS THE PAGE: Civic Blueprint carries the signature headline word and card top borders. Fieldwork Amber anchors the founding-year numeral in Section 3. Measured Teal (#0D9488) appears as the metadata focus-area tag background on team cards. Plinth Gray (#94A3B8) handles all caption and secondary label text. Survey Line (#334155) provides all ruled dividers and table borders. Datum White (#FFFFFF) is primary text on all dark surfaces. Grid Chalk surfaces are body text in Survey Line.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY: DM Sans 800 for all headlines and the founding-year numeral. DM Sans 600 for team member names. IBM Plex Sans 15–16px / 1.6 line-height for all body and description copy. IBM Plex Mono 11–12px / 0.15em letter-spacing uppercase for eyebrow labels, metadata tags, and the ruled annotation beneath the signature headline. Monospace numerals appear wherever years, counts, or metrics surface.

DENSITY AND WHITESPACE LOGIC: Section 1 is tight — 64px vertical padding, no visual breathing room, maximizing the masthead register. Section 2 is the densest section — 6-card grid with 24px gutters, 32px internal card padding, minimal whitespace to enforce the analytical data-panel feel. Section 3 loosens slightly with generous column padding to let the founding narrative read as a considered editorial statement rather than a data dump.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On tablet, the team grid collapses to 2 columns. On mobile, it becomes a single-column stacked list. The signature headline in Section 1 scales down to ~48px on tablet and ~36px on mobile, maintaining the color break on "Draw." Section 3's two-column split stacks vertically on mobile with the founding-year numeral moving above the body copy. The page header masthead rule remains full-width at all breakpoints.

CROSS-PAGE FIT: This page shares the Axiom Slate / Grid Chalk surface alternation established across the site, the IBM Plex Mono eyebrow system, and the Civic Blueprint primary action color. It distinguishes itself from the Projects page (gallery-first, image-dominant) by being purely typographic and data-structured — no project photography, no full-bleed image panels — making it the most text-dense, analytically rigorous page in the site sequence.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Inquiries page functions as the studio's intake terminal — a structured, data-dashboard-inflected contact experience that transforms the act of reaching out into the first step of a diagnostic process. The page must feel like filling out a technical brief, not a generic web form. Three sections sequence from a commanding header through a dense inquiry form to a numbered process grid, creating a deliberate rhythm of sparse → dense → structured-sparse that mirrors the studio's analytical voice.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: A full-bleed typographic stunt in the page header — the word "CONVERSATION" set at display scale (clamp between 96px and 160px) in DM Sans 800, all-caps, tracked tight at −0.04em, rendered in Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) and allowed to overflow the grid container horizontally, bleeding past the right edge of the layout. This oversized display word sits behind the headline stack as a background typographic layer, partially masked by the Axiom Slate panel surface, creating a dashboard-readout effect where the data bleeds beyond the viewport — the visual metaphor of information that exceeds the frame. This move is entirely grounded in the data-heavy aesthetic's "dashboard panels" and "large numerals" visual cues, adapted here to typographic scale rather than numeric scale.

SECTION SEQUENCE AND RHYTHM:
— Section 1 (Page Header): Axiom Slate (#1C2333) full-bleed background. Asymmetric left-anchored layout, wide left gutter, sparse copy density. The signature typographic bleed moment lives here. Compact vertical padding (80px top, 60px bottom) keeps it lean — this is a header, not a hero.
— Section 2 (Contact Block): Grid Chalk (#F0F2F5) surface with Survey Line (#334155) grid-rule borders framing the form panel. Maximum density — this is the page's operational core. The form fields are styled as data-entry terminals with IBM Plex Mono labels, monospace field indicators, and a left-rail sidebar carrying the body copy and metadata. Generous vertical padding (100px top and bottom) to give the dense form room to breathe without losing its technical register.
— Section 3 (Feature Grid): Axiom Slate (#1C2333) returns as the background, closing the page in the same dark register it opened in. Three numbered steps rendered as a horizontal indexed list — not cards, but a structured data row with vertical Survey Line dividers between steps. Civic Blueprint used for the step numerals at display weight. The CTA sits below the grid, left-aligned, styled as a text-link with a Fieldwork Amber (#D97706) right-arrow indicator rather than a filled button, signaling navigation rather than submission.

COLOR LOGIC: The page alternates Axiom Slate / Grid Chalk / Axiom Slate — a dark-light-dark sandwich that creates analytical authority without relying on accent color for section differentiation. Civic Blueprint (#2563EB) is deployed expressively in the signature moment and the step numerals. Fieldwork Amber (#D97706) marks the eyebrow labels and the CTA arrow. Measured Teal (#0D9488) appears on the form submission button as a positive-action signal. Plinth Gray (#94A3B8) handles all metadata, captions, and secondary descriptors. Datum White (#FFFFFF) carries primary text on all dark surfaces.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY: DM Sans 800 all-caps for the signature bleed word and section H1. DM Sans 700 sentence-case for H2 section headlines. IBM Plex Sans 15–16px / 1.6 line-height for body and form description copy. IBM Plex Mono uppercase 11–13px / 0.14em letter-spacing for all eyebrow labels, form field labels, step category tags, and metadata annotations. Large monospace numerals (IBM Plex Mono 700, 48px) for the three process step numbers in Section 3.

DENSITY LOGIC: Section 1 is intentionally sparse — the oversized type does the visual work, not the copy. Section 2 is the densest section on the page, with a two-column layout (sidebar + form) and five structured form fields with monospace labels. Section 3 returns to moderate density with a three-column indexed grid and minimal descriptive copy per step.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On mobile, the Section 1 bleed word scales down to 64px and clips at the viewport edge. Section 2 collapses to a single column with the sidebar copy stacked above the form panel. Section 3 collapses the three-column step grid to a vertical stacked list with horizontal rule dividers between steps. All grid-rule borders and Survey Line dividers are preserved at all breakpoints as structural elements, not decorative ones.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
SECTION 1 — PAGE HEADER. Full-bleed Axiom Slate (#1C2333) background. The section occupies the full viewport width with 80px top padding and 60px bottom padding. No CTAs in this section. No imagery. The visual weight is carried entirely by the typographic bleed moment and the color contrast between the Civic Blueprint ghost layer and the Datum White headline above it.

SECTION 2 — CONTACT BLOCK. Grid Chalk (#F0F2F5) full-bleed background. 100px top and bottom padding. This is the page's densest section — the operational core — styled as a data-entry terminal panel, not a conventional web form.

LAYOUT: 12-column grid split asymmetrically into a left sidebar (columns 1–4) and a right form panel (columns 5–12), separated by a 1px vertical Survey Line (#334155) rule that runs the full height of the section content area. This vertical rule is a structural grid line, not a decorative divider.

LEFT SIDEBAR (columns 1–4):

HEADLINE: 'Start the Diagnostic Conversation' — DM Sans 700, sentence case, 28px, line-height 1.15, tracking −0.02em, Survey Line (#334155) on the light surface. 16px top margin from eyebrow.

BODY: 'We accept inquiries for projects of all scales — from a single neighborhood plaza to a citywide public realm strategy. Preferred project types include plazas, parks, promenades, civic squares, linear parks, and resilience landscapes. We are currently accepting projects commencing in Q3 2025 and beyond.' — IBM Plex Sans, 14px, 1.65 line-height, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8), 24px top margin. This quieter tone signals that the sidebar is informational scaffolding, not primary content.
Below the body copy, add a small data badge: a Survey Line-bordered rectangle containing the text 'ACCEPTING: Q3 2025+' in IBM Plex Mono uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.14em, Measured Teal (#0D9488). 32px top margin from body.

RIGHT FORM PANEL (columns 5–12):
The form panel has a Datum White (#FFFFFF) background, 2px Survey Line (#334155) border on all sides, and 40px internal padding. It reads as a dashboard input panel — a contained data-entry surface within the larger Grid Chalk section.

Each of the five form fields is rendered as a structured data-entry row:
— Field label: IBM Plex Mono uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.14em, Survey Line (#334155). Label sits above the input with 8px gap.
— Field description: IBM Plex Sans, 13px, Plinth Gray (#94A3B8), sits below the label with 4px gap, above the input box.
— Input box: 1px Survey Line (#334155) border, 12px internal padding, Grid Chalk (#F0F2F5) background, IBM Plex Sans 15px Survey Line text. On focus: border upgrades to 2px Civic Blueprint (#2563EB).
— Fields are separated by a 1px Survey Line (#334155) horizontal rule and 24px vertical spacing between each.

FIELD ORDER (matching items):
1. 'PROJECT TYPE' — text input. Description: 'Please describe the civic typology: plaza, park, streetscape, corridor, or other.'
